verdict.rationale: Signifyd has configurable Decision Center policies at checkpoints, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no version history, change review, or rollback for those policies. Cancelling a guarantee is an order-level action, not an automation rollback, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
